scope: Application bounded automatic callback profiles; no live merchant compatibility claim
source_network_policy: Source IP allowlisting is optional defense in depth; never replaces cryptographic authentication. No provider IP list is guessed.

volet_usd_sci.authentication: SHA256 SCI plus authenticated order and incoming transaction confirmation
volet_usd_sci.transaction: ac_transfer UUID bound to authenticated transaction
volet_usd_sci.amount: Original gross and authenticated amountIncome; full same-asset, provider/local fee zero
volet_usd_sci.receiver: Original encrypted invoice receiving wallet, SCI/API credentials and authenticated transaction destination

coinpayments_ipn.authentication: HMAC-SHA512 header over exact raw body and signed merchant; IPN version1.0 required
coinpayments_ipn.transaction: txn_id; automatic receipt policy accepts 1..39 ASCII letters/digits/hyphens, longer IDs require reconciliation
coinpayments_ipn.amount: amount1 equals original gross at configured original currency scale
coinpayments_ipn.receiver: Signed merchant matches original invoice/profile; bounded no-checkout mode freezes configured merchant/key hash at first authenticated acceptance. Current key/merchant drift requires reconciliation.
coinpayments_ipn.timestamp: No signed timestamp; permanent transaction-ID idempotency
coinpayments_ipn.status: simple/button/api; status 2 or >=100 complete, other nonnegative pending, negative rejected

yoomoney_http.authentication: HMAC-SHA256 sign; obsolete SHA1 never used
yoomoney_http.transaction: operation_id; automatic receipt policy max39 bytes
yoomoney_http.amount: Signed withdraw_amount equals original gross; signed amount is received net
yoomoney_http.receiver: Original encrypted checkout wallet and pre-invoice notification-key hash; no receiver field in provider payload
yoomoney_http.timestamp: Signed ISO datetime with explicit offset; first acceptance creation minus300, future plus300, maxage86400; replay retains original epoch
yoomoney_http.status: p2p-incoming/card-incoming; unaccepted true pending; test/protected rejected

webmoney_hash2.authentication: SHA256 LMI_HASH2; all supplied hash variants must match; unsigned prerequest never authenticates
webmoney_hash2.amount: LMI_PAYMENT_AMOUNT equals original gross at scale2
webmoney_hash2.receiver: Signed original receiving purse plus original encrypted invoice description and notification-key/timezone proof
webmoney_hash2.timestamp: Signed local calendar date; installation explicitly configures IANA timezone, no inferred provider default; invalid calendar/DST gap/fold reject; first creation minus300/future plus300, replay does not re-age
webmoney_hash2.status: LMI_MODE0; positive HOLD unsupported; prerequest only original-order validation

paykassa_sci_order.receiver: Original encrypted invoice receiver, destination tag, provider invoice and payment-link hash
paykassa_sci_order.timestamp: No signed callback timestamp; permanent transaction-ID idempotency
paykassa_sci_order.verification_work: Original protected invoice/current key/profile preflight before I/O; fixed merchant/key budget default10 per minute (validated env1..1000), per-order cooldown30seconds, verified-token SHA256 cache7days; failed/uncertain work consumes quota; exact cached retry rechecks original proof and performs zero I/O
